user.title: Autodarts board
user.description: Enter the address of the PC that runs the Autodarts Board Manager. The board must be switched on for the setup.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Autodarts PC, e.g. 192.168.1.50.

error.cannot_connect: The Board Manager does not answer. Check the address and that the board PC is on.

abort.already_configured: The board is already set up.

board_error.message: The board answered {path} with HTTP status {status}.

invalid_start_value.message: The start value must be 101, 170, 301, 501, 701 or 901.

invalid_mode.message: Check-in and check-out must be straight, double or master.

unknown_field.message: Unknown field "{field}". Use e.g. T20, D16, S5, S25, D25 or M.
